name: Moosend
summary: Email marketing and automation platform — drag-and-drop campaigns, automation workflows, landing pages and subscription forms, priced by contact-list size with a 30-day free trial and pay-as-you-go email credits as an alternative.
best_for: small businesses and marketers who want affordable email marketing and automation with a low entry price, a real free trial and a clean drag-and-drop builder
skip_if: you run a very large list where per-subscriber pricing adds up, or you only need transactional/API email — a developer-focused sender is cheaper for that
honest_knock: The friendly $7-9 headline is the entry rate at the smallest list size (500 contacts), and the ladder above it does not fall smoothly: paid annually, 8,000 contacts costs $51 a month while 10,000 costs $70, so a list of 9,000 sits on the wrong side of the sharpest jump on the slider. The same reversal repeats at 100,000 and at 600,000. Read the comparison table before you assume Pro covers you, too: transactional emails, SSO and SAML, a dedicated IP, hosted files and an account manager are Moosend+ add-ons or Enterprise rather than included.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month for 500 contacts billed yearly ($9 monthly), rising with list size
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-06 and again 2026-09-30) A 30-day free trial with no credit card. Pro is priced by list size across 21 steps from 500 to 1,000,000 contacts, quoted monthly, biannually (sold as 15% off) or annually (sold as 20% off). At 500 contacts it is $9 monthly, $8 biannual and $7 annual. The ladder is not monotonic per contact: paid annually, 8,000 contacts is $51 a month against $70 at 10,000, 75,000 is $333 against $499 at 100,000, and 500,000 is $2,317 against $2,829 at 600,000 — three steps up the slider that cost more per head than the step below them. The discounts round to whole dollars and so land short at small sizes: at 1,000 contacts $16 monthly becomes $14 biannual (12.5% off) and $13 annual (18.75% off). Instead of a subscription you can buy email credits outright with no expiry: 350,000 for $350, 500,000 for $500, 750,000 for $750 and 1,000,000 for $1,000 — a flat $0.001 per email with no volume discount. Above Pro the page shows Moosend+ (a custom plan assembled from add-ons: dedicated IPs, transactional emails, audience discovery, custom dashboards, hosted files, extra team members, SSO and SAML) and Enterprise, both quote-only. On 30 September 2026 all 21 steps on all three billing terms and the four credit packs were identical to the September reading. The comparison table allows 2 team members on the trial and 5 on Pro, with 10 or more on Enterprise, and the FAQ says credit buyers get a notification at 80% use. Re-read on 9 October 2026 from the page's own selector, Pro per month billed monthly / biannually / annually: 500 $9 / $8 / $7, 1,000 $16 / $14 / $13, 2,000 $24 / $20 / $19, 3,000 $32 / $27 / $26, 5,000 $48 / $41 / $38, 8,000 $64 / $54 / $51, 10,000 $88 / $75 / $70, 25,000 $160 / $136 / $128, 50,000 $315 / $268 / $252, 75,000 $416 / $354 / $333, 100,000 $624 / $530 / $499, 150,000 $936 / $796 / $749, 200,000 $1,216 / $1,034 / $973, 250,000 $1,520 / $1,292 / $1,216, 300,000 $1,808 / $1,537 / $1,446, 400,000 $2,352 / $1,999 / $1,882, 500,000 $2,896 / $2,462 / $2,317, 600,000 $3,536 / $3,006 / $2,829, 700,000 $4,080 / $3,468 / $3,264, 800,000 $4,640 / $3,944 / $3,712, 1,000,000 $5,840 / $4,964 / $4,672.
